title: Before the Bell
logline: A schoolgirl in Ethiopia races through her morning (lost shoe, missed breakfast, the departing service bus) and arrives just in time to stand with everyone and sing the national anthem.
style_block: nostalgic hand-painted storybook illustration, soft early-morning light, warm palette of ochre, sky blue, eucalyptus green and terracotta, gentle paper texture, subject centred in frame, cinematic, no text, no letters

character.name: Little girl (the narrator as a child)
character.description: a ten-year-old Ethiopian girl with dark brown skin, round face and bright eyes, black hair in two neat braids tied with white ribbons, wearing a school uniform of a navy blue V-neck sweater over a light blue collared shirt, a navy pleated skirt, white socks and black shoes, carrying a small red backpack

shots.reason: Establishing shot: an Addis Ababa neighbourhood before sunrise sets the time (very early) and the place before we meet her.
shots.image_prompt: an Ethiopian city neighbourhood before sunrise, deep blue sky with a thin orange glow on the horizon, corrugated tin roofs, eucalyptus trees, one small house with a single warm lit window
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in toward the lit window, sky slowly brightening, static horizon
shots.narration: ልጅ እያለሁ ቀኔ የሚጀምረው ከፀሐይ በፊት ነበር።
shots.narration_en: When I was a child, my day started before the sun.

shots.reason: Close-up on her sleepy face: we attach to her through a feeling everyone knows - not wanting to get up.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of the girl in bed under a colourful woven blanket, eyes squinting half open, hair messy, a mother's hand gently on her shoulder, dim warm lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly opens her eyes and rubs them, camera static
shots.narration: እናቴ «ተነሺ! ታረፍጃለሽ!» ስትል፣ ዓይኔን መግለጥ እንኳን ያቅተኝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: My mother would call, "Get up! You'll be late!" and I could barely open my eyes.

shots.reason: The comic beat of the morning rush: one shoe on, searching for the other. Energy rises.
shots.image_prompt: the girl hopping on one foot in a small living room, one black shoe on and one in her hand, looking under a sofa, morning light through a curtain, cosy cluttered Ethiopian home
shots.motion_prompt: she hops and looks around quickly, slight handheld camera
shots.narration: ከዚያ ሩጫው ይጀመራል። አንድ ጫማ እግሬ ላይ፣ ሌላኛው የት እንደገባ አይታወቅም።
shots.narration_en: Then the rush began. One shoe on my foot, the other nowhere to be found.

shots.reason: Insert on the details of getting ready - bread, backpack, ribbon - compresses the rush into one image.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a child's hands grabbing a piece of dabo bread from a kitchen table next to a small red backpack and a white hair ribbon, cup of tea steaming
shots.motion_prompt: hands quickly pick up the bread, steam rising, camera static
shots.narration: ዩኒፎርሜን ለብሼ፣ ዳቦዬን በእጄ ይዤ፣ ቦርሳዬን አንጠልጥዬ...
shots.narration_en: Uniform on, bread in my hand, backpack on my shoulder...

shots.reason: The chase: the service bus is leaving. The peak of tension in the morning.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of the girl running down a dusty neighbourhood road toward a white school minibus waiting at the corner, her braids flying, early golden sunlight, long shadows
shots.motion_prompt: she runs toward the bus, camera tracks slowly behind her
shots.narration: ሰርቪሱ ጥጉ ላይ ደርሶ ነበር። ሮጥኩ፣ ሮጥኩ... ደረስኩበት!
shots.narration_en: The service bus was already at the corner. I ran and ran... and I made it!

shots.reason: Release after the chase: friends and chatter on the bus. This is the warm social heart of the morning.
shots.image_prompt: inside a school minibus, the girl sitting by the window laughing with two school friends in the same navy uniforms, morning sun through the windows, cosy and joyful
shots.motion_prompt: the children laugh and talk, sunlight flickering through the window, camera static
shots.narration: በሰርቪሱ ውስጥ ጓደኞቼ ነበሩ። ወሬ፣ ሳቅ፣ የትናንትናው ጨዋታ ታሪክ።
shots.narration_en: My friends were on the bus. Chatter, laughter, stories of yesterday's games.

shots.reason: Arrival and play: tag in the schoolyard shows the freedom before the day's order begins.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a school compound with a dusty yard, children in navy uniforms playing tag, the girl running and laughing in the centre, classroom buildings with blue doors, eucalyptus trees, bright morning
shots.motion_prompt: children run and chase each other, camera slowly pans with them
shots.narration: ትምህርት ቤት ስንደርስ፣ ደወሉ እስኪደወል ድረስ አባሮሽ እየተጫወትን ነበር።
shots.narration_en: At school, we played tag until the bell rang.

shots.reason: The turn from chaos to order: the whole school in straight lines, flag rising. The film slows down here.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a school morning assembly outdoors, rows of children in navy uniforms standing in straight lines, a green, yellow and red flag rising on a tall pole, clear blue sky, soft morning sun
shots.motion_prompt: the flag rises slowly and waves gently, children stand still, camera slowly tilts up
shots.narration: ከዚያ ሁላችንም በሰልፍ ቆመን፣ ሰንደቅ ዓላማው ሲወጣ እናያለን።
shots.narration_en: Then we all stood in lines and watched the flag go up.

shots.reason: Emotional peak: her face while singing the anthem - small girl, big feeling. This is the line the film is built around.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of the girl standing straight in line, singing with pride, chin up, eyes bright, morning sun on her face, other children softly blurred behind her
shots.motion_prompt: she sings softly, a gentle breeze moves her ribbons, very slow push in
shots.narration: ብሔራዊ መዝሙሩን ስንዘምር፣ ትንሽ ብሆንም ትልቅ ሆኖ ይሰማኝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: When we sang the national anthem, I was small, but I felt big.

shots.reason: Resolution: calm after the rush. She sits at her desk and smiles - the day, and the film, settle.
shots.image_prompt: the girl sitting at a wooden school desk in a sunlit classroom, chalkboard behind her, red backpack on the bench, opening a notebook and smiling, warm calm light
shots.motion_prompt: she opens her notebook and smiles, dust floating in the sunlight, slow zoom out
shots.narration: ከዚያም ወደ ክፍል። ቀኑ ገና መጀመሩ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: And then, to class. The day had only just begun.
